paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage.

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the changes in loss and validation loss over training steps for two experiments. The x-axis is labeled "Step", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60,000, marked at intervals of 10,000 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", with a custom scale, ranging from 2 10^{0} to 1.2 10^{1} with intercepts at 2 10^{0}, 3 10^{0}, 4 10^{0}, 6 10^{0}, 10^{1}, 1.1 10^{1} and 1.2 10^{1}. There are two solid lines and two dashed lines on the plot. The blue solid line represents "Ex1 Loss", starting at around 4 10^{0} at 0 steps and decreasing sharply till 2 10^{0} at 10,000 steps, then steadily to approximately less than 2 10^{0} by 60,000 steps. The cyan solid line represents "Ex2 Loss", starting at above 3 10^{0} at 0 steps and decreasing to around 2.5 10^{0} at 20,000 and then remains stable till reaching 2 10^{0} by 60,000 steps. The blue dashed line represents "Ex1 Validation Loss", starting just above 1.1 10^{1} at 0 steps and decreasing sharply till 3 10^{0} at steps close to 10,000, leveling off around 3 10^{0} by the end. The cyan dashed line represents "Ex2 Validation Loss", starting slightly below 1.1 10^{1} and decreasing to around 4.5 10^{0} at step around 100, and then gradually leveling off around 3.5 10^{0} by 60,000 steps. Both dashed lines maintain a consistent trend after initial declines. The dashed line don't intersect the solid lines. A legend is given top right.
